feature: Add the reusable workflow a-wf-deploy-state.yml: it deploys the Terraform/OpenTofu state backend described by a state config (Azure resource group, storage account and optional private container, or an S3 bucket including S3-compatible endpoint options). Call a-wf-setup-ci.yml with config-profile: state first and pass its env and default-location outputs. setup's dry-run (default true) only plans without cloud access; destroy is rejected.
Add the config-profile input to a-wf-setup-ci.yml. config-profile: state requires only cloud and the backend fields, makes state_container_name optional, and rejects configs that define stacks.
Add location and create-container inputs to a-wf-setup-state.yaml, so a storage account can be deployed before any container and in a chosen location.
bugfixes: a-wf-setup-state.yaml created and updated storage accounts with anonymous blob access allowed; it now disables it and creates containers private.
a-wf-setup-state.yaml logged an error but continued when the storage account existed in another resource group; the run now fails.
breaking: a-wf-setup-state.yaml now disables anonymous blob access on every Azure storage account it touches, including existing accounts. Anything reading public blobs from a state account loses that access.
docs: Document state configs, a-wf-deploy-state.yml and the deployed resources on the Backends page; correct the claim that setup rejects configs without stacks.
